schema_note: Each case has name, family, direction, root, expected_stack, strict_bytes, and notes. Planned cases may not have fixture bytes yet.

cases.name: ethernet
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Ethernet II frame with an experimental ethertype and raw payload fallback.

cases.name: arp-request
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. ARP who-has request with documentation IPv4 and deterministic local MAC values.

cases.name: ipv4-icmp
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. IPv4 ICMP echo request with DF, checksum, length, and raw payload preservation.

cases.name: ipv6-icmp
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. IPv6 ICMPv6 echo request with flow label, hop limit, checksum, and payload.

cases.name: dns-query
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. IPv4 UDP DNS A query for example.com.

cases.name: vlan-ipv4-udp
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. 802.1Q PCP and VLAN ID with IPv4 UDP payload.

cases.name: raw-payload-link
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Raw link bytes decode as raw and roundtrip without interpretation.

cases.name: arp-reply
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. ARP is-at reply covers opcode, sender and target hardware/protocol addresses.

cases.name: arp-request-reply-roundtrip
cases.notes: Standard Ethernet/IPv4 ARP request and reply byte preservation: hardware_type 1, protocol_type IPv4, HLN 6, PLN 4, and the 6-octet MAC / 4-octet IPv4 sender and target addresses must round-trip unchanged (RFC 826 base header; target/arp-rfc/scope.md). Guards the existing ethernet_arp golden bytes; fixture bytes wired by later materialization steps.

cases.name: arp-unknown-opcode-raw
cases.notes: Structurally valid ARP with an unknown numeric operation value (for example RFC 5494 experimental OP_EXP1 24 / OP_EXP2 25 or an unassigned numeric opcode) must decode as ARP, preserve the raw u16 operation, and never be remapped to request/reply (arp-parameters-1; RFC 5494; target/arp-rfc/scope.md). Fixture bytes wired by later materialization steps.

cases.name: arp-variable-address-lengths
cases.notes: Nonstandard hardware_length / protocol_length ARP (for example HLN 8 and PLN 16, plus zero-length HLN/PLN) must split sender and target address byte vectors by HLN/PLN, preserve the bytes accurately, and not overflow (RFC 826 generic format; arp.yaml address_fields byte_vectors; target/arp-rfc/scope.md). Uses documentation address space only. Fixture bytes wired by later materialization steps.

cases.name: arp-gratuitous-probe
cases.notes: RFC 5227 gratuitous announcement and probe ARP are expressed through base REQUEST/REPLY with specific sender/target field conventions (zero sender or target protocol address; no new opcode), not a new ARP variant (RFC 5227 updates RFC 826; target/arp-rfc/scope.md assumption 2). Fixture bytes wired by later materialization steps.

cases.name: arp-trailing-raw-payload
cases.notes: Extra bytes after a complete ARP body remain observable as raw payload after the ARP layer (spec: trailing bytes preserved as Raw; RFC 826 fixed body length is HLN/PLN-derived). Fixture bytes wired by later materialization steps.

cases.name: arp-family-rarp-inarp-codepoints
cases.notes: ARP-family operation codepoints in scope as codepoint-only round-trippable values with no extension message bodies: RARP 3/4 (RFC 903), DRARP 5/6/7 (RFC 1931), InARP 8/9 (RFC 2390), ARP-NAK 10 (RFC 1577), MAPOS-UNARP 23 (RFC 2176). They ride the unmodified RFC 826 wire format (arp-parameters-1; target/arp-rfc/scope.md). MARS opcodes 11-22 and other unassigned values are deferred to data-only recognition (no named ergonomics). Fixture bytes wired by later materialization steps.

cases.name: vlan-boundary-fields
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. 802.1Q boundary case for PCP 7, DEI 1, VLAN ID 4094, and payload preservation.

cases.name: linux-cooked-ipv4-udp
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Linux cooked capture boundary with IPv4 UDP payload and deterministic address fields.

cases.name: null-loopback-ipv4-little-endian
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. BSD null loopback little-endian IPv4 family header followed by ICMP payload.

cases.name: null-loopback-ipv6-big-endian
cases.notes: BSD null loopback big-endian IPv6 family header followed by ICMPv6 payload.

cases.name: ipv4-udp
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Covers IPv4 UDP length, checksum, ports, and raw payload.

cases.name: ipv4-tcp-syn
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Covers TCP SYN fields, sequence, window, and IPv4 checksum.

cases.name: ipv4-boundary-fields
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. IPv4 TOS, TTL 0, reserved/DF/MF flags, max fragment offset, unknown protocol raw fallback, and automatic total length/header checksum.

cases.name: ipv4-unknown-protocol-raw
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Unknown IPv4 protocol number must preserve the payload as raw bytes.

cases.name: ipv4-fragment-mf-offset
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. IPv4 nonzero fragment offset with MF set validates flags, offset units, and payload boundaries.

cases.name: ipv4-ttl-255
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. IPv4 TTL 255 with DF and raw fallback complements the TTL 0 boundary case.

cases.name: ipv4-options
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Covers EOL, NOP, record-route, and generic IPv4 option encodings.

cases.name: ipv4-options-source-route-traceroute
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Loose source route, strict source route, traceroute, and padding bytes must remain stable.

cases.name: ipv6-boundary-fields
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. IPv6 traffic class, max flow label, hop limit 0, payload length, and raw fallback.

cases.name: ipv6-unknown-next-header-raw
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Unknown IPv6 next header must preserve the payload as raw bytes; this also covers flow label 0 and hop limit 255.

cases.name: ipv6-fragment-udp
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. IPv6 fragment extension header validates offset, M flag, ID, next-header chaining, and UDP payload.

cases.name: ipv6-routing-generic
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Generic IPv6 routing extension validates header length, next-header chaining, and raw tail preservation.

cases.name: ipv6-mobile-routing
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Mobile routing header variant uses 2001:db8 addresses and validates routing type preservation.

cases.name: ipv6-segment-routing-udp
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Segment routing header validates segment list, segments-left, next-header chaining, and UDP payload.

cases.name: ipv6-extension-chain-tcp-raw
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. IPv6 routing extension must decode before TCP and preserve TCP raw payload.

cases.name: ipv6-routing-icmpv6
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. IPv6 routing extension chains into ICMPv6 echo while preserving checksum and payload.

cases.name: udp-ipv6-checksum-length
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. UDP over IPv6 validates pseudo-header checksum, UDP length, and payload preservation.

cases.name: udp-ipv4-zero-checksum
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. UDP over IPv4 zero checksum is valid and must remain distinguishable from recomputed checksum cases.

cases.name: tcp-all-flags-reserved-offset
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. TCP all flags, reserved bits, data offset, window, urgent pointer, and payload preservation.

cases.name: tcp-options
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Covers MSS, SACK permitted, timestamp, window scale, and option padding.

cases.name: tcp-options-sack-blocks
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. TCP SACK block option validates repeated block boundaries and stable option encoding.

cases.name: tcp-options-mptcp-fastopen-edo-generic
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. MPTCP, Fast Open, EDO, and generic TCP option encodings must be preserved even if parsed generically.

cases.name: tcp-udp-unknown-ports-raw
cases.notes: Unknown UDP and TCP ports should avoid higher-level protocol decoding and preserve raw payload.

cases.name: icmpv4-echo-reply
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. IPv4 ICMP echo reply complements the oracle echo request case.

cases.name: icmpv4-destination-unreachable
cases.notes: IPv4 ICMP destination unreachable includes quoted packet fields and checksum.

cases.name: icmpv4-time-exceeded
cases.notes: IPv4 ICMP time exceeded validates type/code and quoted header preservation.

cases.name: icmpv4-parameter-problem
cases.notes: IPv4 ICMP parameter problem validates pointer field, type/code, and quoted payload.

cases.name: icmpv4-redirect
cases.notes: IPv4 ICMP redirect validates gateway field and quoted original packet.

cases.name: icmpv4-extensions-mpls
cases.notes: ICMP extension header and MPLS object validate class/type, length, label, traffic class, S bit, and TTL.

cases.name: icmpv6-errors
cases.notes: IPv6 destination unreachable, packet-too-big, time exceeded, and parameter problem variants with quoted packets.

cases.name: dns-response-records
cases.notes: DNS response with A, AAAA, CNAME, PTR, MX, TXT, NS, TTLs, flags, counts, and compressed names.

cases.name: dns-a-aaaa-records
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Authoritative DNS response with A and AAAA answers for documentation IPv4/IPv6 addresses, stable TTLs, and both answer orderings; strict bytes in both directions.

cases.name: dns-name-records
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Authoritative DNS response carrying NS, CNAME (root-adjacent target), and PTR answers, each a nested <domain-name> as DnsRecordData::Name; uncompressed and strict bytes in both directions.

cases.name: dns-name-records-compressed
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. NS, CNAME, and PTR answers whose owner and embedded RDATA names are compression pointers in the Scapy-owned raw bytes; libcrafter normalizes to the same uncompressed DnsRecordData::Name model on decode (reference_to_libcrafter only, normalized byte policy).

cases.name: dns-mx-txt-records
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Authoritative DNS response with one MX answer (preference + nested exchange name) and TXT answers covering a single string, multiple strings, an empty string, a non-UTF-8 binary string, and a 255-octet character-string; uncompressed and strict bytes in both directions.

cases.name: dns-record-soa
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Focused authoritative response carrying one SOA answer exercising MNAME, RNAME, SERIAL, REFRESH, RETRY, EXPIRE, and MINIMUM; uncompressed nested names and strict bytes in both directions.

cases.name: dns-record-srv
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Focused authoritative response carrying one SRV answer exercising priority, weight, port, and the nested target name; uncompressed target and strict bytes in both directions.

cases.name: dns-soa-srv-records
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Authoritative response carrying one SOA answer (MNAME, RNAME, SERIAL, REFRESH, RETRY, EXPIRE, MINIMUM) and one SRV answer (priority, weight, port, nested target) in a single message; uncompressed and strict bytes in both directions.

cases.name: dns-raw-unknown-records
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Authoritative response carrying an unknown private-use numeric TYPE (65280) plus the deferred NSEC3PARAM (51), TLSA (52), KEY (25), and NAPTR (35) types, each as opaque RDATA carried via DNSRR(type=N, rdata=...) on the Scapy reference; libcrafter decodes every answer to DnsRecordData::Raw and recompiles the same bytes. Strict bytes in both directions.

cases.name: dns-edns-opt-basic
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. Response carrying several EDNS(0) OPT pseudo-records in the additional section with a root owner name and empty option list, spanning the bare default, non-default UDP payload sizes (512, 1232, 65535) in the OPT CLASS, a non-zero extended RCODE, a non-default EDNS version, and the DO flag set and clear packed into the OPT TTL. Scapy DNSRROPT and libcrafter DnsRecord::opt pack the same wire fields, so strict bytes hold in both directions.

cases.name: dns-multiple-questions
cases.notes: DNS message with multiple questions where supported, using example.com and example.net names.

cases.name: dns-generic-record-truncated-rcode
cases.notes: DNS generic record data, truncation flag, nonzero rcode, counts, TTLs, and raw RDATA preservation.

cases.name: dhcp-discover
cases.notes: Oracle fixture case. DHCP discover validates op, htype, hlen, xid, flags, chaddr, hostname, parameter request list, pad, and end.

cases.name: dhcp-request-offer-ack
cases.notes: DHCP request, offer, and ack variants cover ciaddr, yiaddr, siaddr, giaddr, sname/file, router/DNS lists, and lease timers.

cases.name: dhcp-inform-release-generic-options
cases.notes: DHCP inform and release variants cover client identifiers, host/domain text, renew/rebind timers, pad/end, and generic options.

cases.name: pcap-scapy-ethernet
cases.notes: Scapy-written pcap decoded by libcrafter with link type, packet count, and packet bytes compared.

cases.name: pcap-scapy-null-loopback
cases.notes: Scapy-written null loopback pcap validates datalink mapping and decoded packet bytes.

cases.name: malformed-ethernet-short
cases.notes: Short Ethernet header must produce a structured error and must not panic.

cases.name: malformed-ipv4-lengths-options
cases.notes: Short IPv4 header, inconsistent total length, bad IHL, overlong header, and invalid option size cases.

cases.name: malformed-ipv6-extensions
cases.notes: Bad IPv6 payload length and truncated extension header cases.

cases.name: malformed-tcp-options
cases.notes: TCP data offset mismatch, invalid option length, and option overrun must return structured errors.

cases.name: malformed-dns-compression
cases.notes: DNS compression loop, impossible pointer offset, out-of-range pointer, and truncated question cases.

cases.name: malformed-dhcp-options
cases.notes: DHCP missing magic cookie and truncated option must return structured errors or raw fallback without panic.

cases.name: crafter-raw-payload
cases.notes: libcrafter raw bytes emitted as JSON decode in Scapy as raw payload and reserialize identically.

cases.name: crafter-ethernet-unknown-ethertype
cases.notes: libcrafter Ethernet frame with unknown ethertype decodes in Scapy with raw payload preserved.

cases.name: crafter-arp-reply
cases.notes: libcrafter ARP reply matches Scapy fields and bytes for documentation addresses and MAC values.

cases.name: crafter-arp-unknown-opcode-raw
cases.notes: libcrafter ARP built with an unknown numeric operation via opcode(u16) (for example RFC 5494 experimental 24/25 or an unassigned numeric opcode) emits the raw operation and decodes in Scapy with the same numeric op preserved, neither rejected nor remapped (arp-parameters-1; RFC 5494; target/arp-rfc/scope.md). Fixture bytes wired by later materialization steps.

cases.name: crafter-arp-variable-address-lengths
cases.notes: libcrafter ARP built with nonstandard hardware_length / protocol_length and matching raw address byte vectors (for example HLN 8 / PLN 16, plus zero-length forms) serializes the generic RFC 826 header and decodes identically in Scapy, with byte-accurate variable address fields and no overflow (arp.yaml address_fields byte_vectors; target/arp-rfc/scope.md). Documentation address space only. Fixture bytes wired by later materialization steps.

cases.name: crafter-arp-gratuitous-probe
cases.notes: libcrafter RFC 5227 gratuitous/probe ARP produced through the base builder with explicit sender/target field conventions (no dedicated constructor, no new opcode) decodes in Scapy with identical fields (RFC 5227 updates RFC 826; target/arp-rfc/scope.md assumption 2). Fixture bytes wired by later materialization steps.

cases.name: crafter-arp-family-codepoints
cases.notes: libcrafter ARP-family codepoint-only operations (RARP 3/4, DRARP 5/6/7, InARP 8/9, ARP-NAK 10, MAPOS-UNARP 23) ride the unmodified RFC 826 wire format with no extension message bodies and round-trip through Scapy as numeric operations (arp-parameters-1; RFCs 903/1931/2390/1577/2176; target/arp-rfc/scope.md). MARS opcodes 11-22 stay deferred data-only. Fixture bytes wired by later materialization steps.

cases.name: crafter-vlan-boundary-fields
cases.notes: libcrafter VLAN PCP, DEI, VLAN ID, EtherType, and UDP payload decode identically in Scapy.

cases.name: crafter-linux-cooked-ipv4-udp
cases.notes: libcrafter Linux cooked capture vector validates Scapy link-layer decoding and IPv4 UDP payload preservation.

cases.name: crafter-null-loopback-ipv4-little-endian
cases.notes: libcrafter little-endian null loopback vector validates Scapy IPv4 family decoding.

cases.name: crafter-ipv4-boundary-fields
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv4 vector covers TOS, TTL 0, reserved/DF/MF flags, max fragment offset, automatic length, checksum, and raw fallback.

cases.name: crafter-ipv4-unknown-protocol-raw
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv4 unknown protocol vector validates raw fallback.

cases.name: crafter-ipv4-fragment-mf-offset
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv4 fragment vector validates MF and nonzero fragment offset preservation.

cases.name: crafter-ipv4-ttl-255
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv4 vector covers TTL 255 with DF and raw fallback.

cases.name: crafter-ipv4-options
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv4 options vector covers EOL, NOP, record-route, and generic option bytes.

cases.name: crafter-ipv4-source-route-traceroute
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv4 options vector covers loose source route, strict source route, and traceroute option bytes.

cases.name: crafter-ipv6-boundary-fields
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv6 vector covers traffic class, max flow label, hop limit 0, payload length, and raw fallback.

cases.name: crafter-ipv6-unknown-next-header-raw
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv6 vector covers unknown next header raw fallback, flow label 0, and hop limit 255.

cases.name: crafter-ipv6-fragment-udp
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv6 fragment vector validates next-header chaining into UDP.

cases.name: crafter-ipv6-routing-generic
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv6 generic routing vector validates raw extension chaining.

cases.name: crafter-ipv6-mobile-routing
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv6 mobile routing vector validates home address and raw extension chaining.

cases.name: crafter-ipv6-segment-routing-udp
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv6 segment routing vector validates segment list and UDP chaining.

cases.name: crafter-ipv6-routing-tcp-raw
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv6 routing vector validates extension chaining into TCP and raw payload.

cases.name: crafter-ipv6-routing-icmpv6
cases.notes: libcrafter IPv6 routing vector validates extension chaining into ICMPv6 echo.

cases.name: crafter-udp-ipv4-ipv6-checksums
cases.notes: libcrafter UDP vectors cover IPv4 and IPv6 pseudo-header checksums, length fields, zero checksum where valid, and unknown port raw fallback.

cases.name: crafter-tcp-options
cases.notes: libcrafter TCP vectors cover all flags, reserved bits, data offset, MSS, window scale, SACK, timestamp, MPTCP, Fast Open, EDO, generic options, and payload preservation.

cases.name: crafter-icmpv4-errors-extensions
cases.notes: libcrafter ICMPv4 vectors cover echo request/reply, destination unreachable, time exceeded, parameter problem, redirect, extension header, and MPLS object.

cases.name: crafter-icmpv6-errors
cases.notes: libcrafter ICMPv6 vectors cover echo request/reply, destination unreachable, packet-too-big, time exceeded, and parameter problem.

cases.name: crafter-dns-query-response-compression
cases.notes: libcrafter DNS vectors cover query and response sections, compressed names, common record types, generic records, flags, counts, TTLs, and RDATA.

cases.name: crafter-dhcp-message-matrix
cases.notes: libcrafter DHCP vectors cover discover, request, offer, ack, inform, release, BOOTP fields, client identifier, router/DNS lists, text options, timers, generic options, pad, and end.

cases.name: pcap-crafter-ethernet
cases.notes: libcrafter-written pcap decoded by Scapy with datalink, packet count, timestamps where compared, and packet bytes.

cases.name: pcapng-libcrafter-mixed-links
cases.notes: Mixed link types are checked only where current APIs and file format support them; compare link metadata and decoded packet bytes.
